paper_title: Near-Quantum-Noise Axion Dark Matter Search at CAPP around 9.5 $μ$eV
notes: Paper reports exclusion of axion mass range 9.39–9.51 µeV (converted to eV: 9.39e-6 to 9.51e-6 eV) with coupling sensitivity of 2.7-fold above the KSVZ level. The KSVZ model predicts g_agamma ≈ 1e-16 GeV^-1 at this mass scale; 2.7× above KSVZ yields ~2.7e-16 GeV^-1. This is a mass-independent (flat) bound across the scanned range, encoded as a horizontal line. The paper explicitly states ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³ (100% of local DM halo density). Confidence level is 90% as stated in the paper.
